Field Cut

Field Cut Step by Step

One small step at a time. Do the step. Tap the green button. Move on. Your place is saved if you stop.

Open→Load→Mark→Trim→Order→Fix→Size→Crop→Join→Export

26 steps. About 32 minutes start to finish. You can stop any time. Your ticks are saved.

Keys to remember

SpacePlay or stop
IStart here
OEnd here
EnterSave the clip
AFix the color
Cmd + SSave your work
  1. 1
    About 1 min

    Open Field Cut

    Where: Finder, then the field-cut folder.

    • Open Finder. Press Cmd + Shift + G.
    • Paste ~/ClaudeCodeTest/field-cut and press Return.
    • Double-click index.html.
    You will see: Field Cut opens in your browser with a dark screen and a Load footage button.
    Tip: Use Chrome. If it opens somewhere else, right-click index.html, pick Open With, then Google Chrome. Bookmark the page so it is one click next time. Or double-click Field Cut on your Desktop.
  2. 2
    About 1 min

    Load your videos

    Where: Top of the page, next to **Save project**.

    • Click Load footage.
    • Pick your videos. Or drag them onto the page.
    You will see: Your videos line up on the left under Footage.
  3. 3
    About 1 min

    Find the good part

    Where: The **Source** row in the Timeline at the bottom.

    • Click a video on the left to watch it.
    • Click along the Source strip to jump there. Or press Space to play and stop.
    You will see: The big screen shows the moment you stop on. The wavy shape on the strip is the sound, so you can spot where people talk.
  4. 4
    About 1 min

    Mark the start and the end

    Where: The **In** and **Out** buttons under the big screen, or your keys.

    • Press I where the good part starts.
    • Press O where it ends.
    You will see: IN and OUT times appear at the bottom. A green line and a green bar show on the strip.
  5. 5
    About 1 min

    Save it as a clip

    Where: **Add clip** under the big screen, or the Enter key.

    • Press Enter.
    You will see: A new clip appears under Clips on the left and as a block in the Sequence row at the bottom.
    Tip: Repeat steps 3, 4 and 5 for every good moment before you fix anything.
  6. 6
    NewAbout 2 min

    Cut more pieces from the same video

    Where: Same video. The play strip and the **In** and **Out** buttons.

    • Move to the next talking point you want to keep.
    • Press I where it starts. Press O where it ends.
    • Press Enter to save it as a clip.
    • Do this for each talking point. Skip the parts you do not need.
    You will see: Each piece is a new clip on the left and a block in the Sequence row. Green bars on the Source strip show what you kept.
    Tip: Cut a little off? Fix it in the next step. No need to start over.
  7. 7
    NewAbout 2 min

    Fix a cut that is a little off

    Where: The **Sequence** row at the bottom. Or the buttons by the play controls.

    • Click the clip you want to fix.
    • Drag the left or right edge of its block in the Sequence row.
    • Or move the playhead and click Start here or End here.
    • Keys work too: [ for start, ] for end.
    You will see: The time under the clip name changes. A message says how long the clip is now.
    Tip: A clip must stay at least 0.3 seconds long. Use Left and Right to move one frame at a time.
  8. 8
    NewAbout 1 min

    Put the pieces in the right order

    Where: The **Sequence** row at the bottom. Arrows are also beside each clip on the left.

    • Drag a block left or right in the Sequence row.
    • Or click ▲ and ▼ beside a clip on the left.
    • Click ✕ beside a clip to throw it away.
    • Untick a box to leave a clip out for now.
    You will see: The small number under each name (01, 02, 03) is the order. The joined video plays left to right.
    Tip: Names stay the same when you move clips. Only the small number changes. ✕ never touches your original video.
  9. 9
    NewAbout 1 min

    Undo a mistake

    Where: Top left of the page, **Undo** and **Redo**.

    • Press Cmd + Z to take back your last change.
    • Press Shift + Cmd + Z to put it back.
    You will see: The clip, the trim or the fix goes back the way it was.
    Tip: Undo remembers moves, trims, fixes and deletes. It forgets everything when you open a project.
  10. 10
    NewAbout 1 min

    Watch the joined video

    Where: **Play joined** beside the play controls.

    • Tick the clips you want. Untick the rest.
    • Click Play joined.
    • Watch and listen. Click Stop preview to stop.
    You will see: Clips play top to bottom. The clip playing is highlighted on the left. The button says Stop preview.
    Tip: Play joined shows straight cuts. Crossfades only show in the exported video.
  11. 11
    About 1 min

    Save your work

    Where: Top of the page, **Save project**.

    • Press Cmd + S. Or click Save project.
    • Pick a place for the file. Click Save.
    You will see: A message says Project saved. You now have a file ending in .fieldcut.json.
    Tip: Save again after big changes. The file holds your clips and fixes. It does not hold your videos, so keep those safe too.
  12. 12
    About 1 min

    Pick a clip to fix

    Where: Left side, under Clips, or the blocks in the Sequence row.

    • Click a clip.
    You will see: The clip gets an orange box. The top right says Editing clip and its name.
  13. 13
    About 2 min

    Make the colors right

    Where: Right side, **Color** tab, then **Quick fix** and **Look**.

    • Press A or click Auto. That is enough for most shots.
    • Same lighting all night? Scroll down and click Apply to all clips.
    You will see: The picture gets brighter and cleaner right away.
    Tip: Natural is the safe pick for news. The A looks are your portfolio styles.
  14. 14
    About 1 min

    Check your fix

    Where: Bar under the big screen.

    • Click Before / after.
    • Click it again to turn it off.
    You will see: The left half is the old picture. The right half is your fix.
  15. 15
    About 2 min

    Pick where it is going

    Where: The bar under the big screen.

    • Click the size for the app: 16:9, 9:16, 4:5 or 1:1.
    • In Full + guide view, drag the picture to move the box. Scroll to zoom.
    • Click Safe zones. Keep faces inside the box, away from the edges. Apps cover the edges.
    You will see: The bright box changes shape. Safe zones add guide lines on the picture.
    Tip: Keys 1 2 3 4 switch sizes.
  16. 16
    NewAbout 2 min

    Crop the picture

    Where: The **Crop** button under the big screen.

    • Click Crop. A box appears on the picture.
    • Drag the box to move it. Drag a corner or edge to resize it.
    • Click Crop again, or press Esc, when you like it.
    • Want it back? Click Reset crop in the Frame tab.
    You will see: The size shows at the top right of the picture. The dark area outside the box is cut off.
    Tip: Crop first. Then pick the frame size and move the picture inside it. The crop goes into the exported video.
  17. 17
    NewAbout 1 min

    Turn or flip a sideways clip

    Where: Right side, **Frame** tab. Scroll to **Rotate and flip**.

    • Click Rotate left or Rotate right to turn it.
    • Click Flip left/right or Flip up/down to mirror it.
    • Click Reset to go back.
    You will see: The picture turns right away. The note under the buttons says what you did.
    Tip: Mirroring flips any writing in the video. Use it only when you must.
  18. 18
    NewAbout 1 min

    Line up the shot with a grid

    Where: The grid menu under the big screen. It says **Rule of thirds**.

    • Open the menu. Pick Rule of thirds, Golden ratio, Center cross, Thirds + center or Diagonals.
    • Put eyes or faces where lines cross.
    • Pick No grid to hide it.
    You will see: Thin lines show on the picture.
    Tip: The grid is only a guide. It never shows up in your exported video.
  19. 19
    About 1 min

    Make voices clear

    Where: Right side, **Audio** tab. The meter is under the big screen.

    • Leave Voice clarity on.
    • Play the clip. Talking should reach about -12 to -6 on the meter.
    • Too quiet? Raise Level.
    You will see: The meter bounces while someone talks.
  20. 20
    About 1 min

    Add your name (only if you want)

    Where: Right side, **Text** tab, then **Watermark all exports**.

    • Tick Add a credit to put your name in the corner.
    • Skip this step to add nothing.
    You will see: Your credit shows in the corner of the picture.
  21. 21
    About 1 min

    Join the pieces into one video

    Where: Top right **Export...** button. In the Export window, the **Clips** menu.

    • Click Export... at the top right.
    • Open the Clips menu. Choose Join ticked clips into one video.
    • Tick only the clips you want in it.
    You will see: One file per size. Its name ends in _Sequence.
    Tip: Pieces play back to back with straight cuts unless you pick a crossfade in the next step. If colors differ, use Apply to all clips in the Color tab.
  22. 22
    NewAbout 1 min

    Blend the pieces with a crossfade

    Where: Bottom bar, **Between clips**. Or the same menu in the Export window.

    • Click Crossfade (the other choice is Straight cut).
    • Pick a length such as 0.5 s.
    • Overlaps show as small dashes in the Sequence row.
    You will see: Picture and sound melt from one clip into the next. The video is shorter by one blend for each join.
    Tip: Start with 0.5 seconds. Shorter feels like a cut. Longer feels dreamy. Play joined shows straight cuts, so check the exported file.
  23. 23
    About 1 min

    Make the videos

    Where: Top right **Export...** button, then the Export window.

    • Click Export....
    • Tick the sizes you want. One to three is plenty.
    • Tick the clips you want on the left (the little boxes).
    • Click Export ticked clips at the bottom of the window.
    You will see: Progress bars fill. The last part says Finishing. A video takes about as long as it plays.
    Tip: Keep this tab open and in front until it finishes. A 5 minute video takes about 5 and a half minutes. If you see red text about memory, tick fewer sizes.
  24. 24
    About 1 min

    Save the videos to your Mac

    Where: The Export window, **Finished files**.

    • Click Save next to each file. Or click Save all.
    • If Chrome asks about downloading several files, click Allow.
    You will see: The button says Saved. The files are in your Downloads folder.
  25. 25
    About 2 min

    Come back to it later

    Where: Top of the page, **Open project**.

    • Open Field Cut again (step 1).
    • Click Open project and pick your .fieldcut.json file.
    • Drag the same videos onto the page.
    You will see: A note says the project is waiting for your videos. Once they load, your clips come back with their fixes.
  26. 26
    About 1 min

    Forgot a key?

    Where: Top of the page, **Shortcuts**.

    • Click Shortcuts.
    You will see: Every key is listed.

You made it.

Your videos are in Downloads. Take a break.

Stuck? Start here.
Pressing keys does nothing.
Click the empty dark area of the page first. A typing box may have grabbed your keys.
It says it cannot read my video.
Phone video from Photos: export it again as Most Compatible, then load that.
My joined video is in the wrong order.
Use ▲ and ▼ on the left to move clips. The top clip plays first. Then export again.
My joined video has only one clip.
Tick every clip you want in the list on the left. Then open Export... and check Clips says Join.
Play joined does nothing.
Tick at least one clip on the left first. Then click Play joined again.
I do not see Crossfade.
Look at the bottom bar, Between clips. You need two or more ticked clips.
It says crossfade needs Fast export.
That video cannot use the fast way. The export used straight cuts. Try a clip that came straight from your camera.
It says fast export is not possible for this file.
Nothing is wrong. It switches to a slower mode and still finishes. Keep the tab open.
The export stopped with an error.
Tick fewer sizes, pick Standard quality, close other tabs and apps, and try again.
Red text about memory.
Tick fewer sizes or export fewer clips at a time.
The page went blank or I closed it.
Open Field Cut again (step 1). Use Open project and drop your videos in (step 15).
I do not hear sound while exporting.
That is normal. The file still has sound. Tick Play sound while exporting if you want to hear it.
I do not know what to do next.
Click Where was I? at the top. It jumps to your next step.
My crop box will not move.
Click Crop first so the box shows. Drag inside the box to move it. Drag a corner to resize it.
The picture looks sideways.
Open the Frame tab. Click Rotate left or Rotate right.
Field Cut guide, version 4, November 2026.
